_comment: Starter quest for a hero of no noble house (non-house races, newcomers to Aldermarch).

default.title: Find Your Footing
default.desc: You are newly come to Aldermarch, far from your own people. Gather your gear at Orlen's Wares, then set out to make your way in this human realm.
default.objective: Buy your starting gear at Orlen's, then set out from Orlens.
